proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5428 distinguishes ṭaṅka with L./P. ṭaṅg and Nepali ṭāṅ from section 2 ṭaṅga with Bengali, Mth., Bhojpuri, Hindi, Gujarati and Marathi ṭāṅg. The branch is selected by the explicit regional comparisons, with intra-IA transmission unresolved. Discovery comparator: N ṭāŋ “leg” (f_5job7kjn2g3se). The full primary entry was reviewed independently of the existing match. Exact survey forms are preserved.
